scripts.push-migrations: pnpm -w run with-env supabase db push && pnpm generate-types
scripts.reset-remote-database: pnpm -w run with-env supabase db reset --linked && pnpm generate-types && pnpm seed-buckets
scripts.generate-types: pnpm -w run with-env supabase gen types --linked > src/database.types.ts && pnpm build
scripts.seed-buckets: pnpm -w run with-env supabase seed buckets --linked
scripts.start-local-stack: pnpm -w run with-env supabase start && pnpm -w run with-env supabase status -o env > ../../.env.generated && pnpm seed-buckets:local
scripts.reset-local-database: pnpm -w run with-env --local supabase db reset && pnpm -w run with-env --local supabase gen types --local > src/database.types.ts && pnpm build && pnpm seed-buckets:local
scripts.seed-buckets:local: pnpm -w run with-env --local supabase seed buckets --local --yes
scripts.generate-types:local: pnpm -w run with-env --local supabase gen types --local > src/database.types.ts && pnpm build
